activation_rule: Only predictions emitted by a main-branch commit containing live-1m-signals-to-5m-target-v1 are included; no backfilled predictions.

signal_definitions.LIVE1M_DOLLAR_CONSENSUS_3M: majority vote of inverse DXY 3-minute return, inverse USDJPY 3-minute return, and positive GBPUSD 3-minute return
signal_definitions.LIVE1M_DXY_INVERSE_3M: position opposite to the last 3 closed one-minute DXY returns
signal_definitions.LIVE1M_COMPOSITE_Z15: position in -z(DXY)-z(USDJPY)+z(GBPUSD) only when absolute composite z is at least 1.5, using trailing 24 one-minute returns
signal_definitions.LIVE1M_EUR_GBP_DIVERGENCE_Z15: contrarian position against EURUSD-minus-GBPUSD relative-return z when absolute z is at least 1.5
signal_definitions.LIVE1M_EURUSD_MOMENTUM_CONFIRMED: take EURUSD 3-minute momentum only when the cross-asset majority agrees
signal_definitions.LIVE1M_EURUSD_CATCHUP: take the cross-asset majority only when relative EURGBP divergence is extreme and implies catch-up
signal_definitions.LIVE1M_NO_TRADE: zero position and zero friction, control

inference_plan.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the seven frozen candidates
inference_plan.required_survival: positive net mean after assumed friction, 95% block-bootstrap lower bound above zero, BH-adjusted p below 0.05, and at least 200 trades

scientific_boundary: Forward paper evidence only. No live broker orders, no profitability claim, and no candidate retuning on the forward holdout.
